text:
Alex: Hey infra — onboarding a new APAC (sin) subscription for a customer-managed GPU pool. Need guidance and quota increases. Requirements: 6x A100 nodes, dedicated GPU subnet, private endpoint to partner.storage, high‑throughput NAT egress (target ~10Gbps), and peering to our central hub-vnet. Can someone help with VNet sizing + the exact quota request text?

Maria: Is this Azure Southeast Asia (sin) or GCP singapore? Also do we need PrivateLink (private endpoint) to the partner or will a service endpoint suffice?

Alex: Azure SE Asia (SoutheastAsia). We require Private Endpoint to partner.storage.azure.net for compliance. Subscription ID: sub-0123-4567. Desired timeline: non-blocking but prefer within 1 week. Top asks: public IP quota bump, NAT gateway IPs for SNAT capacity, and NC A100 compute quota increase.

Jin: For SNAT capacity ~300 concurrent ports, we'll need multiple NAT gateway public IPs. On Azure, NAT gateway supports multiple public IPs attached; recommend 3 IPs as a starting point (each IP increases SNAT port pool). Also recommend a /22 for GPU nodes (about 1024 addresses) so we have headroom for scaling and node replacements.

Alex: Terraform snippet for the requested subnets I was planning to use (paste into the ticket):
```hcl
resource "azurerm_virtual_network" "customer_sin_vnet" {
  name                = "cust-sin-vnet"
  address_space       = ["10.40.0.0/16"]
  location            = "Southeast Asia"
  resource_group_name = "rg-cust-sin"
}
resource "azurerm_subnet" "gpu_pool" {
  name                 = "gpu-pool"
  resource_group_name  = azurerm_virtual_network.customer_sin_vnet.resource_group_name
  virtual_network_name = azurerm_virtual_network.customer_sin_vnet.name
  address_prefixes     = ["10.40.4.0/22"]
}
resource "azurerm_subnet" "infra" {
  name                 = "infra"
  address_prefixes     = ["10.40.8.0/24"]
}
```

Jin: That looks good. Important: Azure reserves 5 addresses per subnet so allow for that. Also add a dedicated route table for the GPU subnet with a default route to the NAT gateway and a specific route for the partner private endpoint ranges.

Sam: I'll open the Azure support case. Proposed quota changes to request: public IPs (increase from default 5 -> 20), regional compute quota for NC A100 v4 family (increase to 10), and NAT gateway public IP attachment limit / SNAT capacity note. Also request expedite flag for the compute quota due to production onboarding.

Alex: Thanks. Can you paste the exact ticket text I can copy into the portal?

Sam: Sure — use this as the support case body:
"We are requesting quota increases for a new customer subscription to support a dedicated GPU fleet in Southeast Asia (SoutheastAsia). Subscription: sub-0123-4567. Required changes: 1) Public IP addresses: increase from 5 to 20 in SoutheastAsia. 2) Compute quota: NC A100 (NCv4) family increase from 0 to 10. 3) NAT gateway SNAT capacity: allow attaching 3 public IPs to enable ~900 SNAT ports (aiming for ~300 concurrent pod connections). Reason: production inference fleet for low-latency ML workloads; timeline: 7 business days preferred. Primary contact: Alex (alex@redwood.example)."

Maria: Add a short cost note in the ticket so support understands it's expected: NAT gateway + extra public IPs will increase monthly infra egress costs; customer has approved.

Jin: Also opened a separate internal request to hub-networking for VNet peering and PrivateLink approval: please allow peering from cust-sin-vnet -> hub-vnet (hub: 10.0.0.0/16). I've included routing constraints: we will use forced tunneling for monitoring traffic to go via hub inspection.

Sam: Case created with MSFT: MSFT-2026-9981. Submitted increases: Public IPs -> 20, NCv4 compute -> 10, NAT gateway multi-IP attachment requested. Expected response: 48-72 hours per Azure support. Assigned to: Sam.

Alex: Great - ping me when case updates arrive. Also can someone confirm estimated egress monthly cost delta for 3 NAT IPs (ballpark)?

Maria: Ballpark: NAT gateway base + IP charge ~ $40-80/mo per extra public IP depending on region + egress data transfer cost (customer expects ~10TB/mo -> estimate $700-1000). I'll run numbers and post a quick spreadsheet.

Jin: Heads-up: if Azure delays compute quota for the specific NC SKU we can fall back to other GPU SKUs (e.g., ND series) but that may impact perf/cost. Keep this as fallback.

deploy-bot: [deployment-check] No active deploys targeting cust-sin-vnet. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Follow-ups: 1) I'll paste the Azure case link when they respond. 2) Hub-networking: please approve peering request in the hub console and confirm route table propagation rules. 3) Maria to send cost estimate.

Alex: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the onboarding steps. :thumbsup:"
